name: Tupelo (United States)
description: Dark blue field charged at the centre with a white disc bearing the All-America City shield in red, white and blue, ringed by the words TUPELO, MISSISSIPPI and the years of the city's awards.
history: Tupelo is a city in and the county seat of Lee County, Mississippi.
